clue.text: Bid from male after male taken in by fake

indicators.note: something taken in by another is held inside it, so the male pieces go within the word for fake

parts.note: cod is an informal adjective meaning fake or mock

indicators.note: the first male comes after the second, so the short form leads and the full word follows

parts.note: a man is a male person
a man is a male person

explanation.surface: A bid is made by one man after another man has been fooled by a fraud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bid' reads as an offer at auction, but here it is the old sense of an order; 'fake' as an adjective is the slangy 'cod'.
explanation.definitionFit: A command is an order, and a bid in its old sense is an instruction or order given to someone.

clue.text: Cloth in fashion kept under bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
ton is fashion or the fashionable set

explanation.surface: Fashionable cloth is stored beneath the bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabric woven from the fibres of the cotton plant is one of the commonest cloths.

clue.text: Thousand or million? I bet that's wrong

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for both a thousand and a million
a stake is money wagered, a bet

explanation.surface: Someone muddles a thousand and a million and is betting it is an error.
explanation.definitionFit: An error is a wrong done by misjudgement; the noun 'wrong' fits as a mistaken act.

clue.text: Specialised soldier in suitable American gear

clue.text: Carefully considers tempo put in by composer

the rate of music is its tempo or speed

explanation.definitionFit: To deliberate is to weigh something carefully, so the verb in the third person matches 'considers'.

clue.text: Not jumping at fence's option to buy

explanation.surface: A horse balks at a fence while a buyer gets first dibs on a property.
explanation.walkthrough: In show jumping a horse that stops at a fence commits a refusal; a first refusal is the right to buy before others.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are fixed uses: a horse's balk at a jump, and the first-option right to purchase something.

clue.text: Origins of Reign of Terror? Nonsense!

indicators.note: the origins of words are their first letters

explanation.surface: Someone scoffs at an account of how the French Reign of Terror began.
explanation.walkthrough: The Reign of Terror was the bloody phase of the French Revolution.

clue.text: What can be accomplished after following moral tale

indicators.note: the word for accomplished comes after the abbreviation for following

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references
able means skilled or accomplished

explanation.surface: A moral story about what can be achieved by following others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What can be' adds to the surface: ABLE also means 'can'.
explanation.definitionFit: A fable is a short story, often with animals, that teaches a lesson or moral.

clue.text: Its upwardly mobile users later go downhill fast

definitions.text: Its upwardly mobile users later go downhill fast

parts.words: Its upwardly mobile users later go downhill fast
parts.note: upwardly mobile suggests social climbers falling from grace; literally the riders are carried up a slope and then race down it

explanation.surface: Social climbers soon decline rapidly.
explanation.definitionFit: A cable-drawn device carries skiers up a slope so they can ski back down quickly.

clue.text: Arrival after journey, trip to south of country

clue.text: High-flier whose performance is often on another plane

definitions.text: High-flier whose performance is often on another plane

parts.words: High-flier whose performance is often on another plane

clue.text: I may be found in farm building, a little one in Yorkshire

parts.note: a barn is a farm building for storing crops or animals

explanation.walkthrough: 'may be found in' puts I inside BARN.
explanation.definitionFit: Bairn is the Scottish and northern English dialect word for a child, used in Yorkshire.

clue.text: Performing song live

parts.note: a performer who is on is appearing on stage
an air is a tune or song

explanation.surface: A singer performs a song live.

clue.text: Graduate's assistance for outstanding work of art

relief is help or aid given to those in need

clue.text: Corrupt careerist engaged in administrative department

parts.note: at means in, as in 'at home'

clue.text: What could make patent endlessly lucrative?

clue.text: Checked text for opera, changing one note

clue.text: Enthusiast has time on continent for piece of music

clue.text: A burden to directors, in general

clue.text: It's due to one's betters, in particular

explanation.walkthrough: 'In particular' and 'in this respect' mean the same, so particular = respect as a noun meaning a detail.
explanation.definitionFit: Esteem owed to superiors, and a detail or aspect, as in 'in every respect'.

clue.text: Bring new false charges and prepare again for hanging

clue.text: Like island in East, turbulent part of Pacific

clue.text: Reportedly change location for union negotiation

clue.text: Life's beginning for Romans — or nearer the end?
